post.description: Creates a new transcript from a media URL in AssemblyAI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

audioUrl.description: Publicly reachable audio or video URL to transcribe.

prompt.description: Contextual prompt text to guide the transcription model.

speechModels[].description: Preferred speech models in priority order.

languageCode.description: Language code for the audio when you want to force a specific language.

punctuate.description: Add punctuation to the transcript output.

formatText.description: Apply text formatting to the transcript output.

multichannel.description: Enable multichannel transcription for multi-track audio.

speakerOptions.description: Options for speaker diarization range handling.

speakersExpected.description: Expected number of speakers for diarization.

audioStartFrom.description: Start transcribing from this millisecond offset.

audioEndAt.description: Stop transcribing at this millisecond offset.

autoHighlights.description: Extract key phrases from the transcript.

contentSafety.description: Run content moderation on the transcript.

contentSafetyConfidence.description: Confidence threshold for the content safety model.

redactPii.description: Redact personally identifiable information in transcript text.

redactPiiPolicies[].description: PII policy list to enable during redaction.

redactPiiAudio.description: Generate redacted audio with spoken PII beeped out.

redactPiiAudioQuality.description: Output file type for redacted audio.

removeAudioTags.description: Remove audio-event tags from transcript text on supported models.

disfluencies.description: Include filler words like um and uh in the transcript.

customSpelling[].description: Custom spelling and formatting rules using to/from values.

keytermsPrompt[].description: Domain-specific words or phrases to improve recognition.

speechUnderstanding.description: Speech-understanding tasks such as translation, speaker identification, or custom formatting.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to receive transcript completion events.

webhookAuthHeaderName.description: Webhook auth header name for completed or failed webhook deliveries.

webhookAuthHeaderValue.description: Webhook auth header value for completed or failed webhook deliveries.

speechThreshold.description: Minimum fraction of speech required in the audio.

languageConfidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence score required when automatic language detection is enabled.
